description: A narrow blue clip over a full-frame red one. The overlay is 32x64 in a 64x64 raster, so fitting it leaves a bar either side — and those bars must be transparent, letting the red bed show through, rather than black. Expect a blue column down the middle with red at the sides. If the letterbox padding were opaque the whole frame would be blue on black and the lower track would vanish, which is the failure this fixture exists to catch.
